title: The Mountain Holds the Clipboard
skyStory: The moon climbs into Capricorn, Nancy's own sign, and immediately starts tidying the place up. Two thirds lit and wearing practical boots, it adjusts the angle of the stars and sets up a filing system for comets. Saturn, Capricorn's ruler, hums in approval. The goat on the mountaintop finally has company that understands spreadsheets.

reading: Capricorn energy has walked into the cabin and asked, politely but firmly, what exactly the plan is. You will need an answer. Not a vision, not a speech, a plan: three steps, maybe four. Write it on the back of an envelope and hand it to the moon.

Your idea from yesterday is still glowing. Good. Now give it a deadline and one small first step that you can finish by dinner. Capricorn is Nancy's moon, and she would build it brick by brick. Borrow her way of doing things for one day. The [[Eight of Pentacles]] is sitting at the workbench, waiting for you to pick up the chisel.
joel.mission: Turn yesterday's big idea into a three-step plan on a single sticky note, and send Nancy a photo for her approval.
joel.omen: A neatly stacked pile of firewood or bricks. Patience will build what enthusiasm started.

reading: The moon is visiting your sign, and the whole sky is suddenly in your handwriting. Every list you write today will be shorter and smarter than usual. Every decision lands like a gavel. People will ask your opinion and actually take it. Enjoy that. It is rare, and you have earned it a thousand times over.

Saturn sends a message by way of a small, satisfying task, the kind with a clear finish line: a form, a shelf, a list of names. Finish it with a flourish. The Mountain does not shout. It just stands there being correct. The [[Queen of Pentacles]] tips her crown at you from her garden throne.
nancy.mission: Approve or reject Joel's sticky note plan with a formal stamp, real or drawn, and one sentence of feedback.
nancy.omen: Stone steps with moss on every third one. Your slow, steady climb is exactly the right pace, and your sign is waving from the top.

together.text: Hold a ten minute strategy session about absolutely anything, even the best way to fold a fitted sheet. Nancy chairs. Joel takes minutes. Saturn attends as a silent observer and will be very disappointed if the meeting runs over.

game.intro: The moon climbs into Capricorn and Nancy's mountain holds the clipboard. Saturn grades on a curve made of nonsense.
game.question: What colour is a school bus?
